<li><details class="history-item" id="2000s-hybridsal"><summary id="trigger-2000s-hybridsal" aria-controls="panel-2000s-hybridsal">HybridSAL</summary><div class="history-panel" id="panel-2000s-hybridsal" role="region" aria-labelledby="trigger-2000s-hybridsal">
<p class="history-panel-title">HybridSAL <span>· 2000s</span></p>
<p>Modeling and verification of hybrid systems through qualitative hybrid abstraction and relational abstraction. HybridSAL extends SAL with continuous dynamics and produces discrete abstractions for analysis with SAL model checkers.</p>
<p><strong>Selected SRI contributors:</strong> Ashish Tiwari.</p>
<p><strong>Collaborators / other affiliations:</strong> Sriram Sankaranarayanan (University of Colorado), coauthor of the 2011 relational-abstraction paper.</p>
<p>Qualitative abstraction builds finite-state models. Relational abstraction summarizes continuous evolution as relations between states; the 2011 paper and 2012 tool paper describe this extension.</p>
<p class="history-source-heading">Papers &amp; project resources</p><ul class="history-sources">
<li><a href="https://www.csl.sri.com/~tiwari/relational-abstraction/relabs-doc.pdf">HybridSAL documentation: qualitative and relational abstraction</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.sri.com/publication/cyber-formal-methods-pubs/abstractions-for-hybrid-systems/">Abstractions for Hybrid Systems (2008)</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.csl.sri.com/users/tiwari/relational-abstraction/relational.pdf">Relational Abstractions for Continuous and Hybrid Systems (2011)</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.csl.sri.com/~tiwari/relational-abstraction/hsal-tool-paper.pdf">HybridSAL Relational Abstracter (2012)</a></li>
</ul></div></details></li>
</ul></div></section>
